Data Engineering Trainee - Databricks

About the role
This is an entry-level / fresher position. You will be trained on Databricks and modern data engineering practices.

Responsibilities
- Build and maintain simple data pipelines under guidance
- Write SQL queries to transform and validate data
- Support ETL/ELT workflows on the Databricks platform

Mandatory Requirements
- SQL / MySQL: strong fundamentals and hands-on query writing, including joins, aggregations, subqueries, CTEs and window functions
- Python: working knowledge of programming fundamentals, debugging and data manipulation

Supporting Skills
- Data engineering concepts
- ETL/ELT
- Data pipelines
- Basic cloud concepts
- PySpark
- Apache Spark
- Databricks

Prior professional experience in Spark, PySpark or Databricks is not mandatory because candidates will receive training.
Certifications are not mandatory.

Desirable attributes
- Analytical and problem-solving ability
- Communication skills
- Adaptability and willingness to learn
